in_marathi.name: Mukti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mukti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mukti is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'muk', meaning 'free' or 'liberated'. In Hindu mythology, Mukti represents the attainment of spiritual liberation and release from the cycle of birth and rebirth. It is a profound and inspiring name for a baby girl.
